name: GreenTrade
summary: GreenTrade is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using moving average systems and momentum indicators to enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It employs systematic entry and exit rules with configurable stop loss and take profit levels, aiming to capture sustained directional moves. The EA is designed for medium-term trading on major currency pairs, focusing on high-probability trend continuation setups.
summary_zh: GreenTrade是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，利用移动平均线系统和动量指标识别市场方向，沿当前趋势方向入场交易。它采用系统化的入场和出场规则，配合可配置的止损和止盈水平，旨在捕捉持续的方向性行情。该EA专为主流货币对的中期交易设计，专注于高概率的趋势延续形态。
strategy_analysis: GreenTrade的策略核心是趋势跟踪，通过移动平均线的排列和交叉来判断市场趋势方向，当短期均线上穿长期均线且动量指标确认时做多，反之做空。入场条件要求趋势方向一致且动量支持，避免逆势交易。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及趋势反转信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户资金的百分比计算，未发现马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。资金管理方面提供了止损比例控制，但缺少最大回撤限制和动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于经典的趋势跟踪系统，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: GreenTrade's core strategy is trend following, using moving average alignment and crossovers to determine market trend direction, entering long when the short-term MA crosses above the long-term MA with momentum confirmation, and vice versa for shorts. Entry conditions require trend direction consistency and momentum support to avoid counter-trend trades. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as position closure triggered by trend reversal signals. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculation on account equity, with no martingale or grid position-scaling logic detected. Money management provides stop loss ratio control, but lacks maximum drawdown limits and dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is clear and follows a classic trend-following system, but may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for distinguishing orders

pros: 策略逻辑清晰易懂，基于经典的趋势跟踪方法，适合初学者理解和使用
具备完整的止损止盈机制，有效控制单笔交易风险，防止极端亏损
参数可配置性强，交易者可以根据不同品种和周期灵活调整参数组合
pros_en: Clear and understandable strategy logic based on classic trend-following methods, suitable for beginners to understand and use
Complete stop loss and take profit mechanism effectively controls single-trade risk and prevents extreme losses
Strong parameter configurability allows traders to flexibly adjust parameter combinations for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生频繁虚假信号，导致连续亏损和手续费侵蚀
缺少最大回撤控制和动态仓位调整机制，无法根据账户状态自适应风险管理
未检测到新K线判断逻辑，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
缺少点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下入场可能显著影响盈利能力
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses and commission erosion
Lacks maximum drawdown control and dynamic position adjustment, unable to adapt risk management based on account state
No new bar detection logic detected, potentially causing repeated entries on the same bar leading to overtrading
Missing spread filter mechanism, entries during high-spread conditions may significantly impact profitability
improvements: 添加新K线判断逻辑，确保每个K线只开仓一次，避免重复交易和过度曝露风险
引入ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡市中减少交易频率，提高信号质量
增加最大回撤限制和动态仓位管理，根据账户净值自动调整风险敞口
improvements_en: Add new bar detection logic to ensure only one entry per bar, avoiding repeated trades and excessive risk exposure
Introduce ADX or volatility filter to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets and improve signal quality
Add maximum drawdown limit and dynamic position sizing to automatically adjust risk exposure based on account equity

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线上重复开仓增加风险敞口
未设置点差过滤，高点差时入场可能造成不必要的滑点损失
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中会产生连续亏损，缺乏市场状态识别过滤
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check mechanism may cause repeated entries on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
No spread filter set, entries during high spreads may cause unnecessary slippage losses
Trend-following strategy generates consecutive losses in ranging markets, lacking market state identification filter
